en: Black-and-white portrait of a costumed stage actor holding a large metal tankard and smiling while looking down. He wears a bald cap with side hair, a curled mustache and beard, a ruffled white shirt, and period-style coat with a broad belt, suggesting a theatrical role. Printed at the bottom are the photographer/publisher credit and the actor's name with the title of the play in German.
